008package paint.viewer.override.recording_exclude;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
013import tech.tablesaw.api.BooleanColumn;
014import tech.tablesaw.api.StringColumn;
015import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
016
017import java.nio.file.Files;
018import java.nio.file.Path;
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.List;
021
022import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
023
024public class ImportRecordingExclude {
025
026    /**
027     * Loads and applies recording excludes to the provided list of {@link RecordingEntry}
028     * objects. If "Recording Exclude.csv" does not exist, this method returns without
029     * modifying anything.
030     *
031     * @param recordingEntries recordings to update in memory
032     * @param projectPath      project root folder containing /Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv
033     */
034    public static void importRecordingExcludes(List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries, Path projectPath) {
035        Path csvPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Exclude.csv");
036
037        if (!Files.exists(csvPath)) {
038            PaintLogger.infof("No Recording Exclude.csv present - no overrides to apply.");
039            return;
040        }
041
042        List<RecordingExclude> excludes = loadRecordingExclude(csvPath);
043        applyInternal(projectPath, recordingEntries, excludes);
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Loads and applies recording excludes to the provided in-memory Recordings table.
048     * If "Recording Exclude.csv" does not exist, this method returns without modifying
049     * anything.
050     *
051     * @param recordingsTable Recordings table to update in memory
052     * @param projectPath     project root folder containing /Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv
053     */
054    public static void importRecordingExcludes(Table recordingsTable, Path projectPath) {
055
056        Path csvPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Exclude.csv");
057
058        if (!Files.exists(csvPath)) {
059            PaintLogger.infof("No Recording Exclude.csv present - no overrides to apply.");
060            return;
061        }
062
063        List<RecordingExclude> excludes = loadRecordingExclude(csvPath);
064        applyInternal(projectPath, recordingsTable, excludes);
065    }
066
067    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
068    // INTERNAL APPLY
069    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
070
071    /**
072     * Applies excludes already loaded from CSV to the provided Recordings table.
073     * This method always resets the full Exclude column to {@code false} first,
074     * and then sets {@code true} only for Recording Names listed in the exclude file.
075     *
076     * @param projectPath      project root folder (currently only used for optional debug output)
077     * @param recordingsTable  target Recordings table to update
078     * @param excludes         list of excludes parsed from CSV
079     */
080    private static void applyInternal(Path projectPath, Table recordingsTable,
081            List<RecordingExclude> excludes) {
082
083        BooleanColumn excludeCol = recordingsTable.booleanColumn("Exclude");
084
085        // Reset all to false first (deterministic)
086        for (int i = 0; i < excludeCol.size(); i++) {
087            excludeCol.set(i, false);
088        }
089
090        // Apply excludes by Recording Name
091        boolean first = true;
092        for (RecordingExclude exclude : excludes) {
093            StringColumn  nameCol       = recordingsTable.stringColumn("Recording Name");
094            String        recordingName = exclude.getRecordingName();
095
096            for (int row = 0; row < recordingsTable.rowCount(); row++) {
097                if (recordingName.equals(nameCol.get(row))) {
098                    excludeCol.set(row, true);
099                    if (first) {
100                        PaintLogger.blankline();
101                        first = false;
102                    }
103                    PaintLogger.infof("Recording excluded: " + recordingName);
104                    break;
105                }
106            }
107        }
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * Applies excludes already loaded from CSV to the provided list of {@link RecordingEntry}
112     * objects. This method always resets all entries to {@code excluded=false} first,
113     * and then sets {@code true} only for Recording Names listed in the exclude file.
114     *
115     * @param projectPath      project root folder (currently only used for optional debug output)
116     * @param recordingEntries target entries to update in memory
117     * @param excludes         list of excludes parsed from CSV
118     */
119    private static void applyInternal(Path projectPath, List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries,
120            List<RecordingExclude> excludes) {
121
122        // Reset all to false first (deterministic)
123        for (RecordingEntry entry : recordingEntries) {
124            entry.getRecording().setExcluded(false);
125        }
126
127        // Apply excludes by Recording Name
128        for (RecordingExclude exclude : excludes) {
129            String recordingName = exclude.getRecordingName();
130
131            for (RecordingEntry entry : recordingEntries) {
132                if (recordingName.equals(entry.getRecordingName())) {
133                    entry.getRecording().setExcluded(true);
134                    PaintLogger.infof("Recording excluded: " + recordingName);
135                    break;
136                }
137            }
138        }
139    }
140
141    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
142    // CSV LOADING
143    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
144
145    /**
146     * Loads all rows from "Recording Exclude.csv" into a list of {@link RecordingExclude}
147     * objects. The file is expected to contain a column named {@code Recording Name}.
148     *
149     * @param csvFile path to Recording Exclude.csv
150     * @return list of parsed {@link RecordingExclude} objects (possibly empty)
151     */
152    public static List<RecordingExclude> loadRecordingExclude(Path csvFile) {
153
154        List<RecordingExclude> recordingExcludeList = new ArrayList<>();
155
156        try {
157            Table table = Table.read().usingOptions(TextFiles.csvReadOptions(csvFile));
158
159            for (int i = 0; i < table.rowCount(); i++) {
160                RecordingExclude recordingExclude = new RecordingExclude();
161                recordingExclude.setRecordingName(table.column(RECORDING_NAME).get(i).toString());
162                recordingExcludeList.add(recordingExclude);
163            }
164        } catch (Exception ex) {
165            PaintLogger.errorf("Error reading Recording Exclude.csv → " + ex.getMessage());
166        }
167
168        return recordingExcludeList;
169    }
170
171}
